We are excited to announce that Pinnacle College of Media, Arts and Communication (PICMAC) has moved to a new and expanded facility in Ibadan. After more than 10 years at our former location at No. 18, Anfani Road, Off Ring Road, Challenge, Ibadan, PICMAC has relocated to our new campus at: No. 56 (Anfani House), Anfani Road, Off Ring Road, Challenge, Ibadan, Oyo State, Nigeria. Our new location gives us more space and improved facilities to provide a better learning experience for our students, trainees, professionals and other members of the PICMAC community. Please note: Our former address at No. 18, Anfani Road is no longer PICMAC's current location. Our new official address is: Pinnacle College of Media, Arts and Communication (PICMAC) No. 56 (Anfani House), Anfani Road, Off Ring Road, Challenge, Ibadan, Oyo State, Nigeria. Why PICMAC Moved to a New Location PICMAC has grown significantly since its establishment, and our new location reflects that growth. Our move to No. 56 (Anfani House), Anfani Road provides us with the opportunity to create a more spacious, functional and conducive environment for learning and professional development. The new facility is designed to support our growing range of programmes and give students more room for practical training, collaboration and hands-on learning. Our new location provides: * More learning and training space * Improved classroom facilities * Better practical training environments * Dedicated spaces for media and creative training * Improved studio and production facilities * A more comfortable environment for students * Greater capacity for physical and professional training programmes * Room for PICMAC's continued growth and expansion The relocation is part of PICMAC's continuing commitment to building capacities, empowering professionals and transforming lives. Welcome to the New PICMAC Campus We invite our students, prospective students, parents, partners, alumni and members of the public to visit us at our new location. Our new campus brings together the learning, practical and creative environments needed to deliver quality training across our various schools and programmes. How to Get to PICMAC's New Location PICMAC is located on Anfani Road, off Ring Road, in the Challenge area of Ibadan. From Challenge From Challenge, proceed toward the Ring Road/Anfani Road axis and follow the signs or navigation directions toward Anfani Road. Continue to No. 56 (Anfani House). Look out for the PICMAC signboard at the new facility. From Ring Road From Ring Road, enter Anfani Road toward the Challenge axis. Continue along Anfani Road until you reach No. 56 (Anfani House), the new PICMAC location. Use Google Maps for the most accurate turn-by-turn navigation based on your starting point. From Mokola Travel toward the central Ibadan/Ring Road axis and continue in the direction of Challenge/Ring Road. From the Ring Road area, follow the route to Anfani Road and continue to No. 56 (Anfani House). From Dugbe Travel from Dugbe toward the Ring Road/Challenge area. Continue toward Anfani Road and follow the road to No. 56 (Anfani House). From Iwo Road Travel toward the Ring Road/Challenge axis. From the Ring Road area, follow the route toward Anfani Road and continue to the new PICMAC facility at No. 56 (Anfani House). Important Navigation Note Because road conditions, traffic patterns and routes may change, visitors should use Google Maps for the latest turn-by-turn directions.
